title: Heuristic schema-lint and decodability probe for interleaved toolcall streaming
creator: Anika Rao
description: Problem: We observe intermittent structured-output failures when model responses stream interleaved tool/function call markers with partial JSON payloads. Existing strict JSON validators reject streams early, producing noisy fallbacks and degraded UX. Goal: build a lightweight heuristic 'schema-lint' and decodability probe harness that runs continuously against streaming outputs (including interleaved tool call tokens) to detect common classes of parse/semantic issues and to measure decoder recoverability. Deliver a test harness, a set of linting heuristics, integration with the streaming telemetry pipeline, and a playbook for runtime fallback decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A runnable probe harness that can feed N models across streaming endpoints with injected interleaved toolcall markers and capture parseability metrics
A documented set of heuristic lint rules (type mismatch, required-key-drop, trailing-comma-recovery, partial-object-reassembly confidence) with test cases
Integration with runtime telemetry: probe emits metrics to datadog/prometheus and creates incidents when decodability drops below threshold
A short remediation playbook for handling failures (retry window, model-variant fallback, relax-schema path) validated against 10 representative prompts
PR with unit tests and end-to-end smoke run merged and release note added for runtime-1.22
implementation_plan: Design probe harness: streaming client that replays model chunks and honors toolcall boundaries; record raw tokens, parser errors, and heuristics
Implement parser wrapper that attempts reassembly heuristics before classifying as hard-fail
Add configuration flags to enable experiment for 10% of traffic on staging/dedicated
Build remediation playbook and add Console alert dashboard
test_plan: Unit tests for each lint rule and reassembly path (happy path + adversarial sequences)
Fuzz harness that interleaves synthetic toolcall tokens with random partial JSON fragments and measures recovery rate
E2E test against hosted and dedicated runtime variants ensuring metrics populate and alerts trigger
Manual review of 10 failing real-world traces (from /logs/structured-output/) and run fix-forward checklist
Performance test verifying probe client adds <5% CPU overhead when sampling 1% of streaming requests
